longBusinessSummary: First Capital Real Estate Investment Trust is an unincorporated, open-ended mutual fund trust. First Capital owns and operates, acquires, and develops open-air grocery-anchored shopping centres in neighborhoods with the strongest demographics in Canada. The Trust is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. On November 24, 2025, the Trust's unitholders approved an internal tax reorganization that was completed by way of a plan of arrangement (the Arrangement). The Arrangement simplified First Capital's organizational structure by eliminating First Capital Realty Inc. as the Trust's wholly owned corporate subsidiary that owned, directly and indirectly, all of First Capital's real property portfolio.
